dependency: ArduinoJson 6.21.6, explicitly selected; OEM minor version unknown
scope: This file records malformed-token diagnostics and one host-only integer-width observation. Historical application evidence comprises 497 complete outputs and 13 first-assertion snapshots; the latter are not completed OEM outputs. Defined returning-assertion continuations and the retained bounded source-policy deviations are recorded separately in program-recipe-continuations-validation.json and program-recipes.md.

differences.reason: Both parsers return InvalidInput. The selected parser retains a partial scalar in its internal document; applications discard the failed document.
The selected parser reads the valid true prefix of this malformed root token; the OEM lexer includes the trailing x and returns IncompleteInput.
The OEM lexer accepts a four-byte token starting with t. The selected library rejects the invalid literal.
The OEM lexer accepts a five-byte token starting with f. The selected library rejects the invalid literal.
The OEM lexer accepts a four-byte token starting with n. The selected library rejects the invalid literal.

host_only.reason: With USE_LONG_LONG=0 ArduinoJson uses unsigned long: 64 bits on the ordinary host, 32 bits on ESP32/i386. The pinned 32-bit replay reproduces the OEM parser's original overflow path exactly.
